visualStyle.color: earth browns, oil black, fire orange

analysis.themes: A prospector becomes an oil baron and sheds every human attachment — capitalism's founding myth told as the manufacture of a monster.
analysis.atmosphere: Ominous vastness; Greenwood's dissonant strings make even empty landscapes feel diseased.
analysis.narrative: An epic ascent that is really a long subtraction — everything human is traded away until only appetite remains.
analysis.visual: Robert Elswit's plains-and-firelight photography gives 1900s California the weight of a creation myth gone wrong.
analysis.characters: Plainview is will personified; Eli Sunday is faith as rival business. Their duel is the century's argument.
